When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I'm not here to be thanked, Hale. I asked you who decided, and I'm waiting.
I'm sorry? I have a call in twenty minutes. Owen.
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, Owen.
